checks.coverage: grader source, runtime-author tests, projection, prefreeze/data-freeze ordering, prediction-to-annotation separation, local receipt verification

exposure.assurance: Reviewer self-attestation in a shared workspace; procedural separation, not independently enforced blindness.

limits: Proposed v1 labels and declared v2 defect families were known during development. These checks are not an independent holdout or human adjudication.
The prefreeze review does not establish performance on the unopened new v2 corpus.
observations: Invented negative checks cover quantified conclusions, blanket qualification, recency versus future ability, spelled scale, source directive adoption, and eight preference meaning families; close positive controls cover supported quantities and employer exceptions.
Grade results remain bounded deterministic rule checks. Passing does not certify semantic faithfulness of unrestricted prose.
Predictions are persisted before measurement opens annotations; packet identity and exact joins are checked. The root comparison pipeline is local drift evidence, without an external seal.
review_scope: Offline pure grader and comparison pipeline code review, with independently invented boundary fixtures.
